entries.justification: Environmental by design: the test makes a REAL request to postman-echo.com; the verification sandbox has no outbound network, so DNS fails (EAI_AGAIN). It cannot pass in this environment regardless of the code. Residual: query-parsing regressions against that live endpoint are not observable here.

Environmental by design: the test makes a REAL request to www.google.com and has no catch handler, so with no outbound network it never calls done() and Mocha times out. Residual: the HTTPS-agent assertion is not observable here.

Runtime incompatibility (likely, not reproduced on another Node): the test supplies a custom lookup that returns a single address; Node 24 (the agent image) calls lookup expecting the all-addresses form and throws ERR_INVALID_IP_ADDRESS before any request. Unrelated to the compression issue. Residual: custom-lookup regressions are not observable on this Node; only this exact code is excused, any other failure of this test is a regression.
As the previous entry (async lookup returning [address, family]): Node 24 lookup contract, ERR_INVALID_IP_ADDRESS before any request. Same residual and exact-code limit.
